jobs.title: (CAN) Distribution Centre Team Associate - Asset Protection (Part Time, 3 Month Contract)
Regulatory analyst - intermediate
jobs.description:
*What we do*

The Alberta Utilities Commission is an independent, quasi-judicial agency of the province of Alberta. The AUC is responsible for ensuring that the delivery of Alberta's utility service takes place in a manner that is fair, responsible and in the public interest.

*The ideal candidate*

This position primarily assists the Commission in processing rate-related applications in order to ensure that the delivery of utility service takes place in a manner that is fair, responsible and in the public interest. This involves providing information and analysis to assist the Commission members in the decision-making process.

To be successful in this role, you should have a background in engineering, exceptional communication skills and possess the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear, understandable information for diverse audiences.

*Key responsibilities*
- Contribute to the review and analysis of utility applications, including business cases, financial schedules, and technical documentation, and provide analysis and written briefings to Commission members.
- Assist in identifying issues requiring further clarification or follow-up and prepare draft information requests to applicants and intervening parties.
- Provide research and advice on various energy-related issues and issues related to applications and regulatory practices.
- Manage the processing of utility rate applications (proceedings) and lead proceeding teams as a lead application officer.
- Work closely with legal counsel on developing hearing questions and preparing for hearings.

*Qualifications*
- Undergraduate degree in engineering (preferred), economics, business, or a related field.
- A minimum of four years of relevant regulatory or utility industry experience.
- A professional designation (e.g. P. Eng. P.L. (Eng.), CPA, CFA) and/or a graduate degree are considered an asset.
- Knowledge of and experience with cost-of-service regulation, performance-based regulation and associated principles.
- Technical writing ability that conveys intended messages to target audiences with clarity and precision.

*How to apply*

Please submit your resume and cover letter to opportunities@auc.ab.ca and include position number 26-008 and your name in the subject line. Applications will be accepted until Friday, August 14, 2026.

Pay: $1.00-$2.00 per year

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Employee assistance program
- Paid time off
- Work from home

Work Location: In person
